page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The host environment supplies eight dedicated vCPUs derived from four physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem is built on the x86_64 Broadwell microarchitecture, providing 40 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AVX, FMA, and AES instruction sets, while lacking newer AVX-512 extensions. Memory capacity is substantial, providing 60 GB of total RAM, which calculates to 7.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is anchored by an integrated NVIDIA Pascal P100 graphics processing unit featuring 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage includes a 472 GB bundled local solid-state drive, accompanied by a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate clear divergence between CPU compute and graphics acceleration capabilities. On synthetic CPU workloads, the instance records lower-tier results, reflecting older processor silicon with a stress-ng single-core score of 954.2 and multi-core score of 4765.11, placing both in the lower quartiles. Memory bandwidth benchmarks also register lower-tier throughput during large block transfers. However, execution metrics pivot sharply upward when leveraging the NVIDIA P100 accelerator. In large language model inference tests, prompt processing on a 7B-parameter model reaches 316.69 tokens per second, and text generation achieves 42.77 tokens per second, both registering in the top 10 percent of recorded benchmarks.

From an efficiency perspective, the instance provides access to dedicated Pascal GPU horsepower and high memory-per-core density without the overhead of newer flagship accelerators. The primary architectural tradeoff lies in the older CPU core performance, modest 3 Gbps networking throughput, and absent public IPv4 addresses, which restricts its viability for general CPU-bound processing, database hosting, or high-throughput web traffic. Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is best suited for GPU-oriented workloads such as machine learning inference, deep learning model evaluation, computer vision preprocessing, and GPU-driven scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance within the ecs.gn5 series, designed for parallel computation and machine learning tasks. It integrates an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor offering 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, combined with 60 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM, complemented by 472 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a 3 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark metrics highlight strong GPU throughput, achieving top-decile performance in 7B-parameter large language model inference for both prompt processing and text generation. Conversely, synthetic CPU benchmarks reflect its older Broadwell microarchitecture, yielding below-average multi-core and memory bandwidth scores. This makes the instance cost-effective for legacy GPU-bound acceleration, batch inference, and scientific computing, rather than CPU-heavy transactional or low-latency general web serving tasks.
